title: Universal at Christmas
h1: Universal at Christmas: what runs on each coast, and the ten days worth booking
description: Holiday overlays at Universal Orlando and Universal Studios Hollywood: what regular admission includes, the optional paid Holiday Tour, and when to go.
summary: Universal Orlando has confirmed its 2026 holiday season, with park entertainment included with admission and an optional paid Holiday Tour. Hollywood’s 2026 holiday event guide gives only a November–December window, so its exact dates still need confirmation. See the Orlando event guide for its confirmed dates.

typicalWindow.startsAround: the middle of November in Orlando, late November or early December in Hollywood
typicalWindow.endsAround: early January in Orlando; Hollywood's exact end varies by year

sections.heading: The short answer
body: Consider the first ten days of December once your chosen park has published its holiday dates. Crowds and prices often rise toward the end of the month, while Hollywood's exact 2026 holiday dates remain unannounced.

There is no hard-ticket Christmas party at Universal. The core parades, shows, castle projection and seasonal decoration run with regular park admission at the relevant park. Universal Orlando's optional 2026 Holiday Tour runs on select dates during its confirmed holiday season, starts at $69.99 plus tax, and requires separate same-day two-park, park-to-park admission to Universal Studios Florida and Islands of Adventure. Check our Orlando event page for its exact dates.
Universal Orlando has historically offered ticketed New Year's Eve experiences as another separate purchase. Check the current year's official program before planning around one.

sections.heading: What runs in Orlando
body: Universal Orlando's holiday layer spreads across the resort rather than concentrating in one park. Universal Studios Florida runs a holiday parade built around balloons and floats from the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, which is the largest single piece of the season and the one worth planning an evening around.

Islands of Adventure carries the Grinch, with a stage show in Seuss Landing and a themed overlay of that land, and the Hogsmeade side of the park runs a projection show on the castle after dark. The castle show is the strongest thing in the Orlando season on a per-minute basis and it is free with your ticket, which puts it among the best value in this month at either resort.

Epic Universe has been folded into the resort's holiday season since it opened, and its programme is newer and less established than the other two parks'. We would not build a trip around it yet, and we would expect it to change between cycles more than the older parks' content does.

sections.heading: What runs in Hollywood
body: Universal Studios Hollywood runs Grinchmas, which turns part of the park into Whoville with a stage show, and it runs the same Wizarding World castle projection show that Orlando does. Between them those two are the season, and both are included with regular admission.

The show schedule matters more here than in Orlando because the park is small and the shows fill. Check the times when you arrive and build the day around them rather than assuming you will catch one in passing. The Grinchmas show in particular has queues that form well before the performance.

Hollywood's holiday season is more compact than Orlando's. Its core shows are included with regular park admission, though ticket prices, parking and optional purchases still matter. Verify the announced dates before booking around Grinchmas.

sections.heading: The date arithmetic, which is the whole of the planning
body: The seasonal content is identical on the fifth of December and the twenty-eighth. The queue is not, the hotel rate is not, and the ticket tier is not. In Orlando the swing across that boundary covers hotel, admission and Express Pass at once, and it is the largest date-driven price difference anywhere on the Universal calendar.

The second half of December is the busiest fortnight of the Universal year at both resorts, and Universal Orlando parks have historically stopped admitting guests on the worst days of it. That is a capacity closure rather than a long queue, and it applies to people holding valid tickets who arrive late.

If you must travel in the peak fortnight, the defence is arrival time and on-site accommodation. Early park admission for hotel guests is worth more in that window than at any other point in the year, and the Express Pass inclusion at the three top-tier Orlando hotels is closest to justifying its premium there.

Southern California schools break up later than many of the states that feed Orlando's holiday travel, so Hollywood holds a lower crowd level further into December. The second and third weeks are a better window in California than in Florida, and the days right after Christmas are worse in California relative to how much park there is.

sections.heading: What this season does not have
body: No separately ticketed Christmas party has been announced at either resort. Core park holiday entertainment is included with admission to the relevant park. Orlando's Holiday Tour is one optional paid add-on; seasonal food, drinks, merchandise and other offered upgrades also cost extra.

No snow-globe weather either. Orlando in December runs low 70s afternoons and the Los Angeles valley runs high 60s, so the holiday content is being delivered in mild weather at both resorts. That is pleasant and it is not what the marketing photography suggests.

Holiday overlays have historically ended in early January, but exact dates vary. Orlando's current end is confirmed in its event guide; Hollywood's has not been announced. Check the current calendar before planning a January trip around holiday content.

universal-orlando.verdict: The first ten days of December, spread across all three parks, with the castle projection show as the fixed point of the trip.
universal-orlando.note: Universal Orlando’s 2026 holiday season dates are confirmed in its event guide. The Macy’s parade is at Universal Studios Florida; Grinchmas is at Islands of Adventure; Epic Universe has new holiday décor in SUPER NINTENDO WORLD and Isle of Berk plus a returning Celestial Park winter presentation. Core park offerings are included with admission to the relevant park; the optional Holiday Tour costs extra.

universal-hollywood.verdict: Grinchmas plus the castle show on a weekday before Southern California schools break, which is later in December than most people assume.
universal-hollywood.note: Universal Studios Hollywood's 2026 event guide lists Grinchmas and the Wizarding World castle projection show in a November–December window but has not published exact start or end dates. Both are regular-admission offerings in the published program. Earlier seasons have extended into early January; verify this year's dates before planning a January visit. The park is compact and performance times should shape the day.

faqs.q: Does Universal sell a Christmas party ticket like the one at the other Orlando resort?
faqs.a: Neither resort has announced a separately ticketed Christmas party. Core parades, shows, projections and decorations are included with admission to the relevant park. Universal Orlando's optional 2026 Holiday Tour starts at $69.99 plus tax and requires separate two-park, park-to-park admission; food, merchandise and other optional purchases also cost extra. Verify any New Year's Eve product when its current terms are announced.

faqs.q: When is the cheapest time to see the holiday content?
faqs.a: Early December is often a lower-cost holiday window than Christmas week, once the program has begun. Check Hollywood's as-yet-unannounced 2026 dates and both resorts' date-specific tickets before booking; Orlando's hotel, admission and Express prices can all rise later in the month.

faqs.q: How bad is the fortnight after Christmas, honestly?
faqs.a: It is the busiest stretch of the Universal year at both resorts, worse than any week in July, and Universal Orlando parks have historically reached capacity and stopped admitting guests on the worst days of it. If you are travelling then, be at the gate before opening every day, stay on site if you can for the early admission, and plan fewer parks than you would otherwise.

faqs.q: Is the holiday season worth a trip on its own?
faqs.a: At Universal Orlando in early December, yes. Three parks, mild weather, low crowds and a full seasonal layer at no extra charge is a strong combination and one of the two or three best weeks of the year to be at that resort. At Universal Studios Hollywood it is a very good day rather than a trip, which is true of that park in every month.

faqs.q: When does the holiday content start and finish?
faqs.a: Universal Orlando’s 2026 dates are confirmed on our Orlando holiday event page and Universal’s official calendar. Universal Studios Hollywood’s 2026 event guide currently identifies the holiday period only as November–December, without exact dates. Confirm Hollywood dates on its official calendar before booking around Grinchmas.

faqs.q: Do I need Express Pass in December?
faqs.a: In the first ten days, no. Crowds are close to their autumn level and the money is better spent elsewhere. In the fortnight from just before Christmas into the new year, yes, or stay at one of the three Orlando hotels that include it, because that is the period when queues are longest and the separately purchased version is at its annual ceiling.
